description: Hold space at a lot for the driver for a few minutes (POST /api/v1/reserve rules). No API key needed. Ask the driver to confirm before calling it. Lots that take payment at their QR page place no hold: you get status pay_at_qr_page and a pay_url to give the driver. A hold is confirmed with POST /api/v1/reserve/confirm before it expires.

agent_platform.description: The assistant you are (recorded on the booking)

duration_hours.description: Hours to book. The result's booking_url opens the lot's pay page on this length

end.description: When the driver leaves (ISO 8601), if they said

idempotency_key.description: Reuse to retry safely. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

intent.description: What the driver needs, in plain words (optional)

plate.description: Plate to pre-fill on the pay page, if the driver said

space_count.description: How many spaces the driver needs

start.description: When the driver arrives (ISO 8601), if they said

ttl_seconds.description: How long the hold lasts, in seconds

vehicle.description: The driver's vehicle, if they said

name: reserve
title: Reserve a space
